description: Authenticated read-only Linura observation reflects authoritative systemd state changes, causal graph relationships, and explicit NetworkManager availability.

steps.name: observation-runtime-present
steps.command: command -v linurad >/dev/null && command -v linuractl >/dev/null && command -v dbus-run-session >/dev/null && command -v systemctl >/dev/null && sudo -n true

steps.name: authenticated-authoritative-observation
steps.command:
dbus-run-session -- bash -euo pipefail -c 'daemon=; unit=linura-observation-acceptance-$$.service; unit_path=/run/systemd/system/$unit; cleanup() { if [[ -n "$daemon" ]]; then kill "$daemon" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$daemon" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; sudo -n systemctl stop "$unit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo -n rm -f "$unit_path"; sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; printf "[Unit]
Description=Linura authoritative observation acceptance fixture
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/true
RemainAfterExit=yes
" | sudo -n tee "$unit_path" >/dev/null; sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload; sudo -n systemctl start "$unit"; linurad >/tmp/linurad-acceptance.log 2>&1 & daemon=$!; ready=0; for _ in $(seq 1 50); do if linuractl capabilities >/tmp/linura-capabilities 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi; sleep 0.1; done; if [[ "$ready" -ne 1 ]]; then cat /tmp/linurad-acceptance.log >&2; exit 1; fi; linuractl whoami >/tmp/linura-whoami; grep -F "uid=$(id -u)" /tmp/linura-whoami; grep -F "actor_kind=service" /tmp/linura-whoami; grep -F "provider=systemd" /tmp/linura-capabilities; grep -F "capability=systemd.unit.observe" /tmp/linura-capabilities; first=$(linuractl observe "systemd:unit:$unit"); grep -F "provider=systemd" <<<"$first"; grep -F "resource=systemd:unit:$unit" <<<"$first"; grep -F "capability=systemd.unit.observe" <<<"$first"; grep -F "authority=native-api" <<<"$first"; grep -F "freshness=current" <<<"$first"; grep -F "attribute.active_state=active" <<<"$first"; explanation=$(linuractl explain "systemd:unit:$unit"); grep -F "provider=systemd" <<<"$explanation"; grep -F "capability=systemd.unit.observe" <<<"$explanation"; evidence_id=$(sed -n "s/^evidence_id=//p" <<<"$explanation"); [[ -n "$evidence_id" ]]; graph=$(linuractl graph); resource_node="resource:systemd:unit:$unit"; capability_node="capability:systemd.unit.observe"; evidence_node="evidence:$evidence_id"; grep -F "node=$resource_node" <<<"$graph"; grep -F "node=provider:systemd" <<<"$graph"; grep -F "node=$capability_node" <<<"$graph"; grep -F "node=$evidence_node" <<<"$graph"; provider_edge=$(grep -F -A3 "edge_from=provider:systemd" <<<"$graph"); grep -F "edge_to=$capability_node" <<<"$provider_edge"; grep -F "edge_kind=provides" <<<"$provider_edge"; resource_edge=$(grep -F -A3 "edge_from=$resource_node" <<<"$graph"); grep -F "edge_to=provider:systemd" <<<"$resource_edge"; grep -F "edge_kind=observed-by" <<<"$resource_edge"; capability_edge=$(grep -F -A3 "edge_from=$capability_node" <<<"$graph"); grep -F "edge_to=$resource_node" <<<"$capability_edge"; grep -F "edge_kind=realizes" <<<"$capability_edge"; evidence_edge=$(grep -F -A3 "edge_from=$evidence_node" <<<"$graph"); grep -F "edge_to=$resource_node" <<<"$evidence_edge"; grep -F "edge_kind=evidence-for" <<<"$evidence_edge"; sudo -n systemctl stop "$unit"; second=$(linuractl observe "systemd:unit:$unit"); grep -F "attribute.active_state=inactive" <<<"$second"; nm_provider=$(grep -F -m1 -A2 "provider=networkmanager" /tmp/linura-capabilities); nm_capability=$(grep -F -m1 -A3 "capability=networkmanager.manager.observe" /tmp/linura-capabilities); grep -F "provider=networkmanager" <<<"$nm_provider"; grep -F "provider=networkmanager" <<<"$nm_capability"; if grep -F "availability=available" <<<"$nm_provider" >/dev/null; then grep -F "support=supported" <<<"$nm_capability"; nm=$(linuractl observe networkmanager:manager); grep -F "provider=networkmanager" <<<"$nm"; grep -F "authority=native-api" <<<"$nm"; grep -F "freshness=current" <<<"$nm"; grep -F "attribute.state=" <<<"$nm"; else grep -F "availability=unavailable" <<<"$nm_provider"; grep -F "reason=" <<<"$nm_provider"; grep -F "support=unsupported" <<<"$nm_capability"; fi'
